choose.when: AND ( UPPER(NVL(P.BID_PBANC_NO, ' ')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO, ' ')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(P.ORDER_PLAN_NO, ' ')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

mapper.sql: P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, COALESCE(P.BID_PBANC_NO, P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO, P.ORDER_PLAN_NO) AS pbancNo, P.PBANC_STEP_CD AS pbancStepCd, STEP.CD_NM AS pbancStepNm, P.PBANC_TYPE_CD AS pbancTypeCd, PTYP.CD_NM AS pbancTypeNm, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt, P.BID_DDLN_DT AS bidDdlnDt, TEAM.TEAM_NM AS sprvsnTeamNm, ( SELECT LISTAGG(JT.TEAM_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY JT.TEAM_NM) FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM PT JOIN TB_TEAM JT ON JT.TEAM_SN = PT.TEAM_SN WHERE PT.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN ) AS joinTeamNms, P.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, STTS.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, RTRN.CD_NM AS rtrnSeNm

LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM TEAM ON TEAM.TEAM_SN = P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD STEP ON STEP.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTP' AND STEP.CD = P.PBANC_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD PTYP ON PTYP.GROUP_CD = 'PBTYP' AND PTYP.CD = P.PBANC_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD STTS ON STTS.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND STTS.CD = P.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD RTRN ON RTRN.GROUP_CD = 'RTRSE' AND RTRN.CD = P.RTRN_SE_CD
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC P
ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC, P.PBANC_SN DESC
ORDER BY P.BID_DDLN_DT ASC NULLS LAST, P.PBANC_SN ASC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT C.CD AS sttsCd, C.CD_NM AS sttsNm, NVL(N.CNT, 0) AS cnt FROM TB_COM_CD C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PBANC_STTS_CD, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_BID_PBANC GROUP BY PBANC_STTS_CD ) N ON N.PBANC_STTS_CD = C.CD WHERE C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ

SELECT , P.ORDER_PLAN_NO AS orderPlanNo, P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO AS bfSpecRgstNo, P.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, P.BID_PBANC_CYCL AS bidPbancCycl, P.TRCK_STTS_CD AS trckSttsCd, TRCK.CD_NM AS trckSttsNm, P.DMND_INST_NM AS dmndInstNm, P.PTCP_SHP_CD AS ptcpShpCd, PTFM.CD_NM AS ptcpShpNm, P.SW_BIZ_YN AS swBizYn, P.BIZ_PRD_CN AS bizPrdCn, P.OPNN_DDLN_DT AS opnnDdlnDt, P.OPENG_DT AS opengDt, P.PRSNTN_DT AS prsntnDt, P.EVL_MTHD_NM AS evlMthdNm, P.LMT_PAGE_CNT AS lmtPageCnt, P.PBANC_DTL_URL AS pbancDtlUrl, P.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS sprvsnTeamSn, RGTR.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, P.REG_DT AS regDt, P.CLCT_DT AS clctDt, P.LAST_CFMTN_DT AS lastCfmtnDt FROM TB_BID_PBANC P
LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD TRCK ON TRCK.GROUP_CD = 'TRSTS' AND TRCK.CD = P.TRCK_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD PTFM ON PTFM.GROUP_CD = 'PTFRM' AND PTFM.CD = P.PTCP_SHP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER RGTR ON RGTR.USER_ID = P.RGTR_ID WHERE P.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}

SELECT H.CLCT_SEQ AS clctSeq, H.PBANC_STEP_CD AS pbancStepCd, STEP.CD_NM AS pbancStepNm, H.PBANC_NO AS pbancNo, H.BID_PBANC_CYCL AS bidPbancCycl, H.PBANC_TYPE_CD AS pbancTypeCd, PTYP.CD_NM AS pbancTypeNm, H.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt, H.BID_DDLN_DT AS bidDdlnDt, H.OPENG_DT AS opengDt, H.API_RSPNS_CN AS apiRspnsCn, H.CLCT_DT AS clctDt FROM TB_PBANC_CLCT_HSTRY H LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD STEP ON STEP.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTP' AND STEP.CD = H.PBANC_STEP_CD LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD PTYP ON PTYP.GROUP_CD = 'PBTYP' AND PTYP.CD = H.PBANC_TYPE_CD WHERE H.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} ORDER BY H.CLCT_SEQ
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE BF_SPEC_RGST_NO = #{bfSpecRgstNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE BID_PBANC_NO = #{bidPbancNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_BID_PBANC ( ORDER_PLAN_NO, BF_SPEC_RGST_NO, BID_PBANC_NO, BID_PBANC_CYCL, PBANC_STEP_CD, TRCK_STTS_CD, PBANC_TYPE_CD, PBANC_NM, ORDER_INST_NM, DMND_INST_NM, SW_BIZ_YN, ALTMNT_BGT_AMT, OPNN_DDLN_DT, BID_DDLN_DT, OPENG_DT, EVL_MTHD_NM, PBANC_DTL_URL, PBANC_STTS_CD, RGTR_ID, CLCT_DT, LAST_CFMTN_DT ) VALUES ( #{orderPlanNo}, #{bfSpecRgstNo}, #{bidPbancNo}, NVL(#{bidPbancCycl}, 0), #{pbancStepCd}, #{trckSttsCd}, #{pbancTypeCd}, #{pbancNm}, #{orderInstNm}, #{dmndInstNm}, #{swBizYn}, #{altmntBgtAmt}, #{opnnDdlnDt}, #{bidDdlnDt}, #{opengDt}, #{evlMthdNm}, #{pbancDtlUrl}, #{pbancSttsCd}, #{rgtrId}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.ORDER_PLAN_NO AS orderPlanNo, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STEP_CD = #{stepCd} AND P.TRCK_STTS_CD = #{trckSttsCd} AND P.ORDER_PLAN_NO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P.PBANC_SN
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET BF_SPEC_RGST_NO = #{bfSpecRgstNo}, PBANC_STEP_CD = #{toStepCd}, PBANC_NM = NVL(#{pbancNm}, PBANC_NM), DMND_INST_NM = NVL(#{dmndInstNm}, DMND_INST_NM), SW_BIZ_YN = NVL(#{swBizYn}, SW_BIZ_YN), ALTMNT_BGT_AMT = NVL(#{altmntBgtAmt}, ALTMNT_BGT_AMT), OPNN_DDLN_DT = NVL(#{opnnDdlnDt}, OPNN_DDLN_DT), CLCT_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PBANC_STEP_CD = #{fromStepCd} AND BF_SPEC_RGST_NO IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.ORDER_PLAN_NO AS orderPlanNo, P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO AS bfSpecRgstNo, P.PBANC_STEP_CD AS pbancStepCd, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ORDER_INST_NM AS orderInstNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.TRCK_STTS_CD = #{trckSttsCd} AND P.BID_PBANC_NO IS NULL ORDER BY P.PBANC_SN
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET BID_PBANC_NO = #{bidPbancNo}, BID_PBANC_CYCL = NVL(#{bidPbancCycl}, 0), PBANC_STEP_CD = #{toStepCd}, TRCK_STTS_CD = #{toTrckSttsCd}, BF_SPEC_RGST_NO = NVL(BF_SPEC_RGST_NO, #{bfSpecRgstNo}), ORDER_PLAN_NO = NVL(ORDER_PLAN_NO, #{orderPlanNo}), PBANC_TYPE_CD = NVL(#{pbancTypeCd}, PBANC_TYPE_CD), PBANC_NM = NVL(#{pbancNm}, PBANC_NM), ORDER_INST_NM = NVL(ORDER_INST_NM, #{orderInstNm}), DMND_INST_NM = NVL(#{dmndInstNm}, DMND_INST_NM), ALTMNT_BGT_AMT = NVL(#{altmntBgtAmt}, ALTMNT_BGT_AMT), BID_DDLN_DT = NVL(#{bidDdlnDt}, BID_DDLN_DT), OPENG_DT = NVL(#{opengDt}, OPENG_DT), EVL_MTHD_NM = NVL(#{evlMthdNm}, EVL_MTHD_NM), PBANC_DTL_URL = NVL(#{pbancDtlUrl}, PBANC_DTL_URL), CLCT_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND TRCK_STTS_CD = #{fromTrckSttsCd} AND BID_PBANC_NO IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT F.FILE_SN AS fileSn, F.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, F.FILE_SE_CD AS fileSeCd, C.CD_NM AS fileSeNm, F.VER_NO AS verNo, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.ORGNL_URL AS orgnlUrl, F.FILE_SZ AS fileSz, F.FILE_EXTN_NM AS fileExtnNm, F.REG_DT AS regDt FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'FILSE' AND C.CD = F.FILE_SE_CD WHERE F.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND F.FILE_SE_CD IN ('FL010', 'FL080', 'FL090') ORDER BY CASE WHEN F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL080' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, F.FILE_SN

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, P.BID_PBANC_CYCL AS bidPbancCycl, P.PBANC_STEP_CD AS pbancStepCd, P.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, P.PBANC_TYPE_CD AS pbancTypeCd, P.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, P.ALTMNT_BGT_AMT AS altmntBgtAmt, P.BID_DDLN_DT AS bidDdlnDt, P.OPENG_DT AS opengDt FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE P.PBANC_STEP_CD = #{stepCd} AND P.BID_PBANC_NO IS NOT NULL ORDER BY P.PBANC_SN

SELECT P.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, P.PBANC_STEP_CD AS pbancStepCd, P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO AS bfSpecRgstNo, P.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo FROM TB_BID_PBANC P WHERE ((P.PBANC_STEP_CD = #{preSpecStepCd} AND P.BF_SPEC_RGST_NO IS NOT NULL) OR (P.PBANC_STEP_CD = #{bidStepCd} AND P.BID_PBANC_NO IS NOT NULL)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F WHERE F.PBANC_SN = P.PBANC_SN AND F.FILE_SE_CD IN ('FL010', 'FL080', 'FL090')) ORDER BY P.PBANC_SN
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET BID_PBANC_CYCL = NVL(#{bidPbancCycl}, BID_PBANC_CYCL), PBANC_TYPE_CD = NVL(#{pbancTypeCd}, PBANC_TYPE_CD), PBANC_NM = NVL(#{pbancNm}, PBANC_NM), DMND_INST_NM = NVL(#{dmndInstNm}, DMND_INST_NM), ALTMNT_BGT_AMT = NVL(#{altmntBgtAmt}, ALTMNT_BGT_AMT), BID_DDLN_DT = NVL(#{bidDdlnDt}, BID_DDLN_DT), OPENG_DT = NVL(#{opengDt}, OPENG_DT), EVL_MTHD_NM = NVL(#{evlMthdNm}, EVL_MTHD_NM), PBANC_DTL_URL = NVL(#{pbancDtlUrl}, PBANC_DTL_URL), CLCT_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PBANC_STEP_CD = #{toStepCd} AND BID_PBANC_CYCL = #{fromBidPbancCycl}

UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET PBANC_STEP_CD = #{toStepCd}, PBANC_STTS_CD = CASE WHEN #{sttsCd} IS NOT NULL AND PBANC_STTS_CD <> 'PS090' THEN #{sttsCd} ELSE PBANC_STTS_CD END, CLCT_DT = SYSDATE, LAST_CFMTN_DT = SYSDATE WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PBANC_STEP_CD = #{fromStepCd}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CLCT_LOG WHERE EXCN_SE_CD = #{excnSeCd} AND EXCN_DT > SYSDATE - #{minutes} / 1440

SELECT L.EXCN_DT AS excnDt, C.CD_NM AS excnSeNm, U.USER_NM AS exctrNm FROM TB_CLCT_LOG L LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'EXCSE' AND C.CD = L.EXCN_SE_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = L.EXCTR_ID WHERE L.PBANC_SN IS NULL ORDER BY L.EXCN_DT DESC, L.CLCT_LOG_SN DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT T.TEAM_SN AS teamSn, T.TEAM_NM AS teamNm, (SELECT LISTAGG(U.USER_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY U.USER_NM) FROM TB_USER U WHERE U.TEAM_SN = T.TEAM_SN AND U.AUTHRT_CD = #{leaderCd} AND U.ACNT_STTS_CD <> #{inactiveCd}) AS leaderNm FROM TB_TEAM T WHERE T.DEPT_CD = #{deptCd} AND T.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY T.TEAM_NM
SELECT CD AS cd, CD_NM AS cdNm FROM TB_COM_CD WHERE GROUP_CD = #{groupCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BID_PBANC SET SPRVSN_TEAM_SN = #{teamSn}, PTCP_SHP_CD = #{ptcpShpCd}, PBANC_STTS_CD = #{toSttsCd}, RTRN_SE_CD = NULL WHERE PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND PBANC_STTS_CD = #{fromSttsCd} AND NVL(SPRVSN_TEAM_SN, -1) = NVL(#{fromTeamSn}, -1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRP_TMMBR (PBANC_SN, USER_ID, PTCP_SE_CD) SELECT #{pbancSn}, #{userId}, #{ptcpSeCd} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PRP_TMMBR M WHERE M.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId})
